tagline.en: Meta AI's Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer — a feed-forward model that recovers 3D geometry from images, with a two-stage 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline.
tagline.zh: Meta AI 的 Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer——从图像前馈式恢复三维几何的模型,并配有两阶段 3D 高斯泼溅(3DGS)流程。

en: VGGT is a 3D reconstruction model from Meta AI (FAIR), presented at CVPR 2025. Given one or more images, its transformer directly predicts 3D geometry — points, depth, and camera information — in a single feed-forward pass, without the slow per-scene optimization that traditional pipelines rely on.

In WorldFoundry it is registered as a two-stage 3D Gaussian Splatting pipeline: VGGT infers scene geometry, which then seeds a 3DGS representation, giving you point clouds and reconstructions from ordinary image input. It is a distinct entry from the related VGGT-World world model.
You feed it images and get back 3D structure — a fast starting point for reconstruction, novel-view work, or downstream 3D understanding.
zh: VGGT 是 Meta AI(FAIR)推出的三维重建模型,发表于 CVPR 2025。给定一张或多张图像,它的 transformer 在一次前馈中直接预测三维几何——点、深度与相机信息,无需传统流程那种缓慢的逐场景优化。
在 WorldFoundry 中,它被注册为两阶段 3D 高斯泼溅流程:VGGT 先推断场景几何,再以此初始化 3DGS 表示,从普通图像输入得到点云与重建结果。它与相关的 VGGT-World 世界模型是不同的条目。
你输入图像,得到三维结构——是重建、新视角合成或下游三维理解的一个快速起点。

whenToUse.en: Choose VGGT when you need fast, feed-forward 3D reconstruction or 3D Gaussian Splatting from images, without running lengthy per-scene optimization.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要从图像做快速、前馈式的三维重建或 3D 高斯泼溅,又不想跑漫长的逐场景优化时,适合选择 VGGT。

notFor.en: It targets geometry and reconstruction from images rather than text-driven video or scene generation; you provide the input views.
notFor.zh: 它面向从图像恢复几何与重建,而非文本驱动的视频或场景生成;输入视角需由你提供。
